jobs.name: ExecuTorch weekly shortlist
jobs.prompt: Use executorch-pm shortlist mode. Read the current Focus part in SKILL.md and collect up to 10 eligible issues within those scopes, reporting shortages without broadening focus, write only issue-disptach.html、issue-disptach.pdf and Result.md in yenhao-huang/daily executorch/<id>_<time>/, present to the user and wait for selection. Never start development or write to community repositories. Preserve existing selections and tracked PR rows in today's Result.md; coordinate with daily checking to avoid duplicate snapshots.

jobs.name: ExecuTorch daily PR progress
jobs.prompt: Use executorch-pm daily Result snapshot mode at 04:00 Asia/Taipei. Every day publish executorch/<id>_YYYY-MM-DD_HHmmss/Result.md in yenhao-huang/daily, even without status changes. Reuse today on reruns and preserve older dates. Use exactly one six-column table from template/Result.md: 選擇的 issue, 選擇 issue, issue 開發, 用戶在社群寄送 PR, 該 PR 被 merge, 目前社群 CI 情況. Preserve concise PR links after stage statuses. Carry forward actual selections, independently tracked PRs, completed rows, check times and evidence; fold legacy second-table evidence into matching rows without inventing selections. Do not append a separate PR-summary table or three-status progress column. Verify one table and exact header order before publishing. Keep prior snapshot and original shortlist links internally. On API failure preserve prior status and last successful check time with a dated uncertainty note. Progress-only days output Result.md alone. Notify only on meaningful changes; quiet notifications must not skip daily output. Never write to community repositories or trigger development.
jobs.scope: PR open/closed/draft/merged status and daily Result snapshot
jobs.persistence: current container lifetime; restart cron after container restart
